# The Radiant Hotel & Resort

> Unrivalled Elegance & Luxury in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Overview
The Radiant Hotel & Resort is a luxury 4-star hospitality destination situated on Medical College Road in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. It combines architectural grandeur and Awadhi royal heritage with contemporary hospitality, offering guest rooms, suites, multi-cuisine fine dining, wellness spa therapies, and celebratory venues.

## Website Navigation & Core Sections
- [Overview](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/): Interactive spatial showcase presenting the hotel grounds, suite collections, dining venues, and event spaces.
- [Rooms & Suites](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/rooms): 6 signature accommodation tiers including Grandeur Suite, Executive Suite, Deluxe Suite, Executive Room, Deluxe Room, and Standard Room.
- [The Seven Scentric Fine Dining](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/dining): Multi-cuisine fine dining restaurant featuring Awadhi heritage recipes, Pan-Asian master wok specialties, and Continental classics across breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
- [Vedic Wellness Spa & Salon](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/wellness): Traditional Ayurvedic treatments including Abhyanga, Shirodhara, deep tissue therapies, herbal steam baths, and bridal salon grooming.
- [Imperial Banquet & Celebrations](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/banquet): Pillarless grand ballroom and starlit open-air royal lawns for luxury weddings, corporate galas, and social gatherings.
- [Malibu Rooftop Lounge](https://radiant-resort.vercel.app/malibu): Open-air rooftop cabana lounge featuring craft mocktails, cocktails, live acoustic sessions, and themed celebration nights.

## Facilities & Amenities
- Accommodation: 6 room and suite categories with private balconies, pool views, and dual-zone suites
- Dining: The Seven Scentric restaurant, 24/7 in-room dining, and Malibu rooftop lounge
- Wellness: Vedic Ayurvedic spa, unisex luxury salon, and fitness centre
- Recreation: Temperature-balanced swimming pool with sun cabanas
- Events: Pillarless grand ballroom and manicured celebration lawns
- Guest Conveniences: 24/7 reception, concierge, dedicated valet parking, and EV charging stations
